text:
This run cannot tell you which hiring plan meets the brief, because the £400k/year salary limit was not checkable.

- All four options were analysed as leaving annual salary spend unchanged: no salary figures were stated for any option. The limit therefore did not form part of the comparison.
- The comparison is fragile, and every estimate it rests on is machine-authored or unattributed rather than user-validated. No option can be put forward from this run.
- The goal direction was also assumed to mean “more platform delivery is better”; that aim was not explicitly recorded.

The missing salary effects are the key model gap: annual salary spend for two seniors, four juniors, current staffing, and two juniors.
